text: Internet Angel Desktop 是面向 DSH Web 的像素风桌面皮肤，通过客户端界面扩展把会话呈现为带开始菜单、任务栏和可拖动窗口的桌面。它将 JINE 对话、POKETTER 结果和任务管理器放进独立窗口，并提供工作区文件浏览、图片查看、番茄钟、待办及 webcam 角色展示。用户还能调整字体、角色、日常界面和声音，适合希望在浏览器中用复古桌面方式组织 DSH 会话的人。需要已运行的 DSH Web；无需额外 API 密钥。

Internet Angel Desktop is a pixel-art skin for DSH Web with a Start menu, taskbar, and movable windows. It separates conversations, tasks, and results, and adds workspace browsing, a Pomodoro timer, and controls for fonts, character display, and sound. Requires DSH Web; no API key.
想把 DSH Web 的会话界面换成像素风桌面。
能不能把聊天、任务和结果分别放进可移动窗口？
我想从当前会话浏览工作区文件并交给宿主预览。
需要一个能保存进度的番茄钟来安排专注和休息。
I want a retro desktop layout for my DSH Web sessions.
Can I browse the current session workspace from inside the skin?
Internet Angel Desktop 的功能「桌面窗口」：管理独立应用窗口的打开、聚焦、最小化与任务栏状态。 通过桌面界面触发。
Internet Angel Desktop 的功能「会话工作区浏览」：在“此电脑”中查看当前会话工作区，并将文件交给宿主预览。 通过桌面界面触发。
Internet Angel Desktop 的功能「番茄钟」：切换专注与休息计时，并保存计时状态供重新载入恢复。 通过桌面界面触发。
想让任务管理和对话结果在不同桌面窗口里显示。
我希望有任务栏，可以快速切回已经最小化的窗口。

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · 这张桌面里有什么：- 可拖动、缩放和最小化的窗口，以及开始菜单、任务栏和存档入口。
- JINE 对话、POKETTER 结果与任务管理器，让长任务有自己的位置。
- webcam 角色展示、代办、番茄钟与中英文界面。
- 控制面板、插件管理器和原生工具共用像素控件。浏览器在桌面与开始菜单，终端在任务栏快速启动区
  任务管理器旁，均以桌面窗框的独立浮窗打开，不会展开右侧栏；任务栏可重新聚焦。
  「直播」用浏览器打开官方频道；JINE 标题栏的放大镜打开独立的聊天记录搜索窗口。
  「此电脑」是 XP 风格的资源管理器，默认浏览当前会话的工作区，文件交给宿主预览；
  左侧的「我的图片」收录 JINE 中出现的图片。工具跟随当前会话，未启用的宿主组件显示为不可用；
  DSH 的 Web profile 默认停用浏览器组件，此时「直播」改在新标签页打开。
- 可通过皮肤管理器调整字体、角色和声音。BGM 与 SE 默认关闭，想听声音记得调高音量。
- 成分复杂的彩蛋。

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · 安装与皮肤管理器：需要已经可以运行的 DSH Web。推荐搭配
[skin-manager 皮肤管理器](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/tree/main/skin-manager)，
用于切换皮肤和调整此皮肤的定制选项。

在终端中依次运行（将 `web` 替换为你使用的 profile 名称）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#path:/skin-manager'
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-internet-angel-desktop'
```

安装完成后重启 DSH Web，在 **设置 → 皮肤管理** 中选择本皮肤。多个皮肤同时启用时，
管理器可能先回到官方默认界面，再手动选择一套即可。本仓库与推荐的皮肤管理器均已公开，可直接使用上面的 GitHub 安装命令。

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · 安装与皮肤管理器：**这是针对 DSH Web 的界面皮肤，不是独立游戏。**宿主兼容声明见 [skin.json](skin.json)；
它不是对其他版本、所有设备或第三方插件的通用兼容承诺。

当前适配目标为 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。桌面与开始菜单提供“插件管理器”，原生插件列表、详情和配置
显示在可拖动、缩放的桌面窗口中；最小化或关闭返回会话，任务栏恢复后打开插件列表。控制面板
跟随 rc2 设置弹层，窄窗口可横向滚动。已验证设置导航、拖动、窗口状态、插件配置编辑与会话草稿保留；
未执行实际插件安装、启停、配置保存或输入法组合输入验证。

Windows 桌面版可在新版皮肤管理器中开启「桌面快捷方式跟随皮肤」，使桌面、开始菜单、
任务栏及窗口图标使用本皮肤的 Windose 应用图标；关闭该开关或切回官方默认时由管理器还原。
图标通过 `skin.json.desktopIcon` 声明并随包分发；开发时运行 `pnpm build:desktop-icon` 可从现有应用图标重建 ICO。

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · 反馈范围：**本项目不受理任何第三方插件兼容性问题反馈。**
大多数插件在这套伪桌面体系中都需要单独适配，其入口、弹窗和布局不能直接套用官方界面。
缺少插件入口、插件窗口被隐藏、与其他插件叠加后的显示异常等，不在本项目的问题受理范围内。
上面推荐的皮肤管理器有明确接入用途，不代表提供通用插件兼容支持。

皮肤自身的问题欢迎反馈。可以让你的 Agent 先定位并整理，再由 Agent 在你授权后
[提交 issue](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-internet-angel-desktop/issues/new/choose)。
请按模板提供 DSH / 皮肤版本、操作系统、浏览器、缩放比例、复现步骤、预期与实际结果，
以及经过脱敏的截图或错误日志。尽量确认问题在关闭其他非必要插件后仍然出现，并搜索已有 issue。
不要上传访问令牌、密钥、完整聊天记录或包含个人目录的日志。

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · 开发：```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm build:manifest

源码位于 `src/`，安装产物位于 `lib/`。素材原文件在 `assets/source/`，登记在 `assets/art.manifest.json`；`pnpm build` 会先把它们按内容哈希复制到 `assets/runtime/`，由皮肤的 node 端路由提供，不再内联进 JS。修改后同步构建产物、运行时素材与构建指纹。
测试集中在 `tests/`；构建和单元测试不能替代真实设备上的视觉与交互验证。
欢迎围绕皮肤本身提供可复现问题和小范围改进。

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · What's on this desktop：- Draggable, resizable, and minimizable windows, plus a Start menu, taskbar, and access to saved sessions.
- JINE conversations, POKETTER results, and Task Manager give long-running tasks their own place.
- A webcam character display, to-do list, Pomodoro timer, and Chinese and English UI.
- Fonts, characters, and audio can be customized through the skin manager. BGM and sound effects are off by default; turn up their volume if you want to hear them.
- An eclectic assortment of Easter eggs.

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Installation and skin manager：You need a working DSH Web installation. We recommend using the
[skin-manager](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/tree/main/skin-manager)
to switch skins and adjust this skin's customization options.

Run these commands in order in your terminal (replace `web` with your profile name):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#path:/skin-manager'
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-internet-angel-desktop'
```

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Installation and skin manager：After installation, restart DSH Web and select this skin under **Settings → Skin Management**. If several skins are enabled at once,
the manager may first return to the official default interface; simply select one skin manually. This repository and the recommended skin manager are both public, so you can use the GitHub installation commands above directly.

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Installation and skin manager：**This is a UI skin for DSH Web, not a standalone game.** See [skin.json](skin.json) for the host compatibility declaration;
it is not a blanket compatibility guarantee for other versions, all devices, or third-party plugins.

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Installation and skin manager：The current adaptation targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. Desktop and Start offer a Plugin Manager window
with native plugin lists, details, and configuration. It supports dragging and resizing; minimizing or closing
returns to chat, and restoring its task opens the plugin list. Control Panel follows the settings portal and
scrolls horizontally at narrow widths. Navigation, dragging, window states, form editing, and chat draft
retention were verified. Plugin installation, toggles, saving configuration, and IME composition were not tested.

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Installation and skin manager：Control Panel, Plugin Manager and native tools share pixel controls. Browser (Desktop and Start) and
Terminal (quick launch, next to Task Manager) open as floating windows in the desktop's window frame
without expanding the right sidebar, with taskbar refocusing. Stream opens the official channel in the
browser, and the magnifier in JINE's title bar opens a separate chat search window. My Computer is an
XP-style explorer over the current session's workspace that hands files to the host preview, with
My Pictures collecting images from JINE. Tools follow the selected session and unavailable host
components are disabled; DSH disables Browser by default in Web profiles, where Stream opens a new tab.

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Feedback scope：**This project does not accept reports about compatibility with any third-party plugins.**
Most plugins need individual adaptation for this simulated desktop. Their entry points, pop-ups, and layouts cannot simply reuse those of the official interface.
Missing plugin entry points, hidden plugin windows, and display issues caused by combining this skin with other plugins are outside this project's support scope.
The skin manager recommended above serves a specific integration purpose; recommending it does not imply general plugin compatibility support.

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Feedback scope：Reports about the skin itself are welcome. You can ask your Agent to investigate and organize the findings, then authorize it to
[submit an issue](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-internet-angel-desktop/issues/new/choose).
Follow the issue template and include your DSH and skin versions, operating system, browser, zoom level, reproduction steps, expected and actual results,
and screenshots or error logs with sensitive information removed. Where possible, confirm that the issue still occurs with other non-essential plugins disabled, and search existing issues first.
Do not upload access tokens, secret keys, complete chat histories, or logs containing personal directory paths.

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Copyright and assets：This project is not a web port of the original game, nor is it officially authorized, sponsored, or endorsed by the original game's rights holders, DSH, or the relevant development teams or publishers.
The project maintainers maintain only the skin implementation and do not own the rights to the third-party game, font, or client assets included in it.

@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-internet-angel-desktop README · Thanks：Thanks to `amechanll` from a certain mysterious forum, and to all the brothers and sisters who have shared their valuable feedback and creative ideas. Thank you for helping make this desktop more fun.
